commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Sergio Herrera makes a huge mistake and Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 2:2.
90+2' Jose Sanchez shows the yellow card to Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) for a heavy challenge.

90+1' What a save from Sergio Herrera! Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
85' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
77' The substitution is prepared. Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nico Williams.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Raul Garcia as he is replaced by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
76' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Jesus Areso and he is replaced by Jorge Moreno (Osasuna).
76' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pablo Ibanez.
74' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
73' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) picks up a yellow card.
72' The attendance is 45273.
72' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
72' The corner from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
68' It's time for a substitution. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) comes on in place of Ruben Pena.
65' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) replacing Mikel Vesga.
63' The game has come to an end for Iker Muniain. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
63' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Ander Herrera is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
58' 1 - 2 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a shot straight inside the left post. Good team effort!
55' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) sees a yellow card from Jose Sanchez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
53' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' 0 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Ruben Garcia (Osasuna), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:2.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch for Alex Berenguer.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
45+2' The foul by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Sanchez.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
40' 0 - 1 Raul Garcia (Osasuna) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
40' Celebrations are cut short for Ath Bilbao as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
40' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez has indicated he is going to review the Ath Bilbao goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
38' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
34' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) gets a yellow card. The referee Jose Sanchez made the right call.
34' Osasuna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
33' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
29' Rough tackle by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
22' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) for a tough tackle.
20' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Raul Garcia (Osasuna) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
13' Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
10' Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
6' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
5' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
